name: Mahou Senshi EXTRA BURST ~Tenshi Danzai~
original_name: 魔法戦士エクストラバースト～天使断罪～
source:
Tomoe Rena lives in the artificial marine city of Zeropolis. Using the power of Encielium Card, she transforms into Enciel Rena — a warrior who fights against evil.

Then a magical warrior Nephile appears before Rena. She claims to have traveled from another world to rescue comrades sealed away by a greater demon Dirac.

After promising to help Nephile, Rena gets swallowed by a sudden spatial distortion and is flung into another world alongside her.

In this new world, a man called Judgment unilaterally punishes "sinners" under the guise of condemnation. The world's magical warriors were already investigating these incidents.

With Judgment, Dirac, and a new evil organization each scheming in the shadows, both Light Angel and magical warriors get dragged into a lewd trial...

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1323938]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
巴丽奈住在人工海洋城市泽罗波利斯。使用Encielium卡的力量，她变身为Enciel Rena——一位与邪恶作斗争的战士。

这时，魔法战士涅菲尔出现在蕾娜面前。她声称自己从另一个世界来到这里，营救被更强大的恶魔狄拉克封印的同伴。

蕾娜答应帮助奈菲尔后，却被突然的空间扭曲所吞噬，与她一起被抛入了另一个世界。

在这个新世界中，一个名为“审判”的人以谴责为幌子单方面惩罚“罪人”。世界魔法战士们已经开始调查这些事件。

审判、狄拉克和新的邪恶组织各自在暗处密谋，光明天使和魔法战士都被卷入了一场淫荡的审判……
